notes:
# v1.4.9 - backend survives interrupted streams instead of crashing

- Fixed: the app no longer loses every connection and its own backend on a long
  run. A single interrupted download or response - for example a cover image the
  phone stops mid-way - could crash the embedded backend process, after which
  every source and the app's own interface stopped responding all at once.
  Interrupted stream and socket events are now treated as harmless, so the
  backend keeps running and the next request succeeds.
- Improved: the local backend now recovers from a busy port on restart instead
  of staying down, and holds connections with proper keep-alive timeouts so a
  half-open connection cannot wedge it.
- Note: no action needed on your part - just update and enjoy.
